channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: After Woman Killed In Front Of Baby On 79th Street, Auburn Gresham Leaders Seek Answers
item.description: A 26-year-old woman was killed in the Wednesday afternoon shooting near St. Sabina Church, officials said. Rev. Michael Pfleger will lead a Friday prayer vigil.

item.title: Temps Rise Above Freezing For The First Time In 3 Weeks
item.description: Temperatures are expected to fall slightly over the weekend, but they should rebound early next week, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Federal Judge Orders Release Of Evidence In Case Of Woman Shot 5 Times By Border Patrol
item.description: Evidence to be released in Marimar Martinez’s case includes about 40 text messages from the phone of the Border Patrol agent who shot her, plus body camera footage, FBI reports and photos of her vehicle leading up to the shooting.

item.title: Man Charged With Murder In Drowning Death Of ‘Captain Bill’ Labor Day Weekend
item.description: Prosecutors said Alexis Trader, 34, pushed Nabil Abzal into a metal grate, causing Abzal to hit his head and lose balance before falling into Lake Michigan.

item.title: Take A Virtual Tour Of Concourse D, O’Hare Airport’s Upcoming Addition
item.description: The Chicago Department of Aviation released an animated video depicting what O'Hare's new Concourse D will look like when finished. The $1.3 billion project is slated to be completed in late 2028.

item.title: Beverly Phono Mart Opens Pop-Up Record Shop While It Recovers From New Year’s Crash
item.description: After a month of operating virtually, the Beverly record store has opened a pop-up shop just a few doors down from the business's storefront that was damaged in a New Year's Day car crash.

item.title: Auburn Gresham Neighbors, Faith Leaders Unite After Woman Killed On 79th Street: ‘Don’t Be Silent’
item.description: St. Sabina’s Rev. Michael Pfleger announced the church is offering a $10,000 reward for anyone with information on the Wednesday afternoon shooting that left a mother dead.

item.title: He Moved His Orphaned Siblings To Chicago Area To Be Their Caretaker. Now, He’s Stuck In ICE Detention
item.description: Federico Alexis Alcantar, 22, is currently being held in a Missouri ICE detention facility. He's been the sole caretaker for his two younger siblings after his father was murdered last year and his mother passed away from cancer in 2022. His community is calling for his immediate release.

item.title: A Cup Of Joe Faced Boycotts For Its Anti-ICE Stance. Neighbors Rallied In Droves To Show Support
item.description: Huge lines formed outside A Cup of Joe Coffeehouse Saturday as it doubled down on its anti-ICE stance following a harassment campaign by some neighbors. Proceeds from Saturday benefitted an immigrant vendors fund.

item.title: City Worker Found Slain In West Ridge Apartment As $10,000 Reward Offered For Information
item.description: Da'J Flowers, who worked for the city's Office of Emergency Management and Communications, was found dead from multiple gunshot wounds Friday, officials said.
